sources.title: ChartHop | Organizational intelligence for people analytics, headcount planning and HCM
quotes: Most HR systems store your data. ChartHop puts it to work — connecting your people and business data into a living model of your organization, so you can see what's changing, model what's next, and act on it in the same place.
ChartHop, the organizational intelligence company: HCM, planning, analytics, agentic AI.

HR and Finance teams at small businesses to large enterprises use ChartHop to plan headcount, run compensation cycles, and answer board-level org questions without waiting on analysts or rebuilding reports from scratch.
Organizational intelligence is everything HR runs, connected to your business data in a living model: HRIS, headcount planning, compensation, performance, engagement, goals, analytics and agentic AI.

sources.title: About ChartHop | The organizational intelligence company
quotes: ChartHop is the organizational intelligence company. Our platform connects your people and business data from any source into a living model of your whole organization, with HCM and planning workflows, visual analytics and agentic AI running throughout, so every decision makes your company stronger.
To connect everything an organization knows about itself into a living model, so every decision is made in context.
